title: Flushing buffered output after halting
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $c$ be a four-tape interpreter configuration on input $x$ with no active state. For any Boolean clock word $b$, after $2|c.	ext{output}|+3$ steps of the timed interpreter from the six-tape lift of $c$ with clock word $b$, the machine has no active state and its real output is the one-bit word $1$ followed by $c.	ext{output}$.
hypotheses_covered: four-tape Boolean interpreter configuration $c$ on input $x$
replaced:
From the six-tape lift of a halted four-tape configuration whose buffered
output is a word $w$, exactly $2|w| + 3$ steps of the timed interpreter halt
the machine with real output the success tag $1$ followed by exactly $w$.
